title: Lemon-Caper Turkey and Asparagus Whole-Wheat Pasta
intro: This fast dinner requires minimal prep and uses a simple skillet technique. Quick-cooking turkey cutlets and whole-wheat angel hair pasta are tossed with asparagus in a bright lemon-caper reduction.

ingredients.name: fresh asparagus
ingredients.preparation: woody ends trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.canonical_name: Soup, chicken broth, low sodium, canned

instructions: Bring water to a boil in a medium pot over high heat. Add the pasta and cook for 3 to 5 minutes.
Stir the asparagus into the boiling water during the final 2 minutes of the cooking time. Drain the pasta and asparagus and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the turkey cutlets for 2 to 3 minutes per side, flipping at the halfway point. Transfer the turkey to a plate.
Reduce the heat to medium. Add the garlic and cook for 30 to 60 seconds, stirring constantly.
Pour the broth, lemon juice, and capers into the skillet. Simmer for 2 to 3 minutes, scraping the pan to release any browned bits.
Return the turkey, pasta, and asparagus to the skillet. Toss for 1 to 2 minutes to coat the ingredients in the sauce.
Remove the skillet from the heat. Divide the meal between plates and garnish with the parsley.
variation: Swap the turkey breast cutlets for thinly sliced chicken breast.
conservation: Keeps 2 days refrigerated; reheat gently in a covered skillet.
